_doc: [v7arc] The whole-game story spine (docs/STORY_ARC.md, docs/ADJUSTING.md 'Story arc'). Home needs two things you can count: FUEL (to fly the Cradle home) and POWER (to wake the Settlers). home.fuel / home.power = what home needs; they must equal the sum of every planet's gives (tests/test_story_arc.gd). planets[id] (ids as in data/homeward.json planets): gives {fuel, power} = what that planet adds to the meters, earned once, when the planet's way onward opens (its exit beat: homeward.json planets[k].leave gate, else restoration reaches chart_at); reason = the one-line reason to go there (the system map, and WREN's 'next' line when the planet before it is done); arrive = WREN's lines on the first rocket landing there (Verdance: the first return, since Lumi first came by pod); leave = WREN's lines at the exit beat, after the home line; question = the mystery it leaves open, answered by the next planet's answers. Builder notes, not shown in game (not translated): from (where the fuel and power come from), answers, ledger (what we learn about the Ledger there). cradle = the last stop: reason is said instead of a 'next' line after the last planet. Templates: {fuel} {power} {fuel_need} {power_need} {planet} {reason}. Data stays English; tr() at display.

home.why: The Cradle needs fuel to fly home and power to wake the Settlers.
home.home_line: To go home we need {fuel_need} fuel and {power_need} power. We have {fuel} fuel and {power} power.
home.full: Fuel and power are full. Build the Homeward rocket on Verdance and fly home.

verdance.from: Fuel from the tanks under the Stack Works smokestack. Power from the Fairground's big wheel cell.
verdance.reason: The Settlers' home, where Lumi's pod fell.
verdance.answers: Why is Lumi alone on a dead world? A meteor storm broke the Cradle open and his pod fell.
verdance.question: The star chart shows four more buried worlds. Why did the Ledger bury them all?
verdance.ledger: A voice on coupons and a few drones. A machine that thinks cleaning costs too much.
arrive: Home again. Look, Lumi: your robots kept cleaning while we were away.
leave: The star map shows four more worlds. The Ledger buried every one. Why?

ochre.from: Power from the old sun mirrors and wind pumps at the pits (two suns, steady wind). Fuel from a parked haul truck's tank.
ochre.reason: Its sun and wind can fill up our power.
ochre.answers: The Ledger dug Ochre first. When the digging stopped paying, it left everything where it fell.
ochre.question: A radio on Tidewell is still calling for help. Is anyone there?
ochre.ledger: Its closure notices: it leaves a world the day digging stops paying.
arrive: Ochre. Hot sand and two big suns. The Ledger dug its very first pit here.
leave: Hear that? A radio on Tidewell, still calling for help after all this time.

tidewell.from: Fuel from sea water, split at the harbour's fuel works. Power from the tide pumps.
tidewell.reason: Its sea water can be made into fuel. And someone is calling.
tidewell.answers: The people left long ago, but they planted mangroves and asked someone to look after them. They are still alive.
tidewell.question: The dredger logs say the Ledger sold the heat of Rime. How do you sell heat?
tidewell.ledger: Its dredgers still run on a timer. Nobody ever told them to stop.
arrive: Tidewell. Islands and rain, and the harbour radio is still on.
leave: The dredger logs say the Ledger sold Rime's heat. How do you sell heat?

rime.from: Fuel from the ice: frozen water makes good rocket fuel. Power from the warm springs under the lakes.
rime.reason: Its ice is frozen fuel, and there is lots of it.
rime.answers: The Ledger drilled out the moon's warm heart and sold it. So the lakes froze.
rime.question: Every Ledger memo is signed by a head office. Where is it?
rime.ledger: Its own sums: 'the moon was not ours to keep warm'.
arrive: Rime. So cold, Lumi. The Ledger took this moon's warm heart.
leave: Every Ledger memo comes from one head office. It is on Anvil.

anvil.from: Power from the Ledger's own foundry reactor, switched on for us once the Ledger sees the sums. Fuel from its last tank.
anvil.reason: The Ledger's head office. Its big reactor has the last power we need.
anvil.answers: The head office is on Anvil. Nobody works there now: only one old audit robot, still counting.
anvil.question: Will the Settlers wake up, and will they like their green home?
anvil.ledger: Its heart: a lonely adding machine. Lumi shows it the sums (clean ground is worth more than trash), and it switches its reactor on for us.
arrive: Anvil. Rust from top to bottom, and the Ledger's lights are still on.
leave: The Ledger balanced its books at last. It is giving us its power.

cradle.reason: Fuel and power are full. Back to Verdance: build the Homeward rocket and fly home.
cradle.answers: Yes. The Settlers wake up, look out of the windows, and see green.
cradle.ledger: The Ledger sends one last coupon: 'Account balanced. Paid in full.'
